name: PostgreSQL (read-only)
description: Query PostgreSQL 12+ (and compatible engines) with SELECT-only access: every statement runs in a read-only transaction that is always rolled back. Use a dedicated account: CREATE ROLE aibi LOGIN PASSWORD '…'; GRANT CONNECT ON DATABASE db TO aibi; GRANT USAGE ON SCHEMA sales TO aibi; GRANT SELECT ON ALL TABLES IN SCHEMA sales TO aibi; ALTER DEFAULT PRIVILEGES IN SCHEMA sales GRANT SELECT ON TABLES TO aibi; ALTER ROLE aibi SET default_transaction_read_only = on;
author: AI BI
